name: Amb. Gbenga Dahunsi
bio:
Amb. Gbenga Dahunsi is the Group Chairman of Intravent Technologies, an ECOWAS Youth Ambassador, Christian Minister, Author, and Speaker. He serves as the Founder and President of Gbenga Dahunsi Ministries International (GDMI), a religious organization committed to organizing crusades, conferences, and charity initiatives across Nigeria. He is also the Founder and Convener of Impact Campus (ICLC), a mentorship and training platform established for human capital development and transformational leadership across campuses in Nigeria and beyond.

A specialist in Peace and Conflict Resolution, Amb. Gbenga Dahunsi brings a unique blend of spiritual leadership, diplomatic insight, and entrepreneurial vision to his role as Group Chairman of Intravent. His leadership is defined by a deep commitment to empowering the next generation of African leaders and building institutions that create lasting impact across the continent and the global digital economy.
shortBio: ECOWAS Youth Ambassador | Author | Speaker | Specialist in Peace & Conflict Resolution
